knowledgeAnswers.rationale: An existing service sold to existing customers is market penetration.
Market development keeps the existing service and moves it to a new group of customers.
Market share is sales divided by total market sales: 150,000 divided by 1,000,000 is 0.15, or 15 per cent. The example figures are invented for teaching.

practicalCriteria: Learner places a supplied set of growth options in the Ansoff quadrants, calculates market share from supplied figures with the source and date of the total, and records one chosen option with a measure and a stop-or-continue result.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical criteria signed off separately by an assessor
evidenceRequired: Completed growth option sheet saved with date and version
Assessor record of knowledge check result
stopWorkCriteria: Learner treats an estimated market total as a confirmed figure
Learner treats a licence, insurance or marketing-law point as settled without checking it
